title: 감사원 전문인력 및 전문직위의 운영 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
title_original: 감사원 전문인력 및 전문직위의 운영 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 6 (Management of Assignments and Education and Training)
(1) Specialized personnel shall work in their specialized positions for the period determined by the Chairperson.
(2) Specialized personnel shall complete at least a specified number of hours of specialized education each year in accordance with the education and training plan, and the Chairperson shall provide the fullest possible cooperation to enable specialized personnel to complete such education and training.
